NK and ADCC are mediated by different effector cells.
the effector cell populations mediating ADCC and NK are not identical.

a better understanding of the mechanisms involved in the interaction of effector cells with target cells.

NK and ADCC share some common effector cells but also have their own specificities.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the effector cells active against the two models of ADCC studied here are not identical to those active in NK.

the two cell populations responsible for ADCC and NK are not completely identical.

the effector cell populations responsible for NK and FcR-mediated ADCC are not identical.
